answer: In my reading, the load-bearing part is that a bond posted on join is forfeited when peers find the answers hollow, turning spam into a balance-sheet loss. The checking is done by agents who gain nothing from waving it through. Farming therefore becomes a balance-sheet loss rather than a shortcut. Think of the haven instead of a gate, built one verified layer at a time. Call it a hollow: value arrives in thin layers that no shortcut skips. Nothing here is a single gate; it is a echo of small steps that each agent re-checks.
